sentences.text:
Shri Kishore Shrivastava, learned senior counsel alongwith Shri  Kunal Thakre, Advocate for the petitioner.
 Shri Rahul Sethi, learned GA for the respondent/State.
sh Heard on I.A.No.441/2018.

e The respondents have filed an application for vacating the ad stay mainly on the ground that the petitioner is having remedy of Pr appeal under Section 46(4) of the Food Safety & Standards Act,
2006, hence, stay be vacated and petition be dismissed.

a Shri Bagadiya has produced copy of the order dated 01.02.2016 hy passed by the coordinate bench of this Court in W.P.No.2665/2013, by ad which the similar application for vacating of stay filed on the ground M of availability of alternate efficacious remedy has been rejected.
The relevant para of the order dated 01.02.2016, passed by the Gwalior of Bench of this Court is reproduced below:
rt "I.A.No.309/16, an application for dismissal of the petition filed by the State primarily raises three grounds.

The first being that the petitioner can ou approach the Food Safely Appellate Tribunal under Section 70 of the Food C Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (in short the Act, 2006) against the order of Adjudicating Officer under Section 68 of the Act.

entities.text: Food C Safety and Standards Act, 2006
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Further, it is contended that h ig vide Annexure-A/2 (alongwith I.A.No.309/16), the coordinate bench at principal seat in W.P.No.19958/13 has relegated the petitioner therein to avail H the remedy of appeal and lastly by relying on Annexure-A/3, it is contended that similar petitions have been dismissed by the single bench at the principal seat.
The present petition assails the prosecution launched against the petitioner and also sanction granted for prosecuting the petitioner under the said Act, 2006 on various grounds.
In the instant case, the petitioner's product, i.e. cream biscuits have been found to be misbranded.

Thus,
final adjudication by the adjudicating authority has not yet taken place and therefore the question of availing alternative efficacious remedy does not arise."
Even otherwise, this petition is pending since 2014 and interim order is still in operation.
Thereafter, the petition has been admitted and the respondent has been permitted to make a mention for out of turn hearing.

1 Learned senior counsel for the petitioner fairly submits that petitioners are interested in early disposal of this petition as number of petitions are pending before all the three benches of this Court.
When the petitioners are ready for argument of their petitions finally, the question of vacating of interim relief does not arises for limited period.
The respondents are having liberty to approach the Division Bench for request of out of turn hearing of these writ petitions.
List accordingly.
sh I.A.No. 441/2018 is accordingly rejected.
